title: First Order Hold
text: Implement linearly extrapolated first order hold on input signal, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial output} sets Initial output; {Output algorithm} sets the output signal approximation technique Slow, {Reset if relative extrapolation error exceeds} sets the error tolerance for solver and {Allow continuous input} applies hold on continuous signals. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port 1
ports.summary: Linearly approximated output signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Output algorithm
params.values: Output signal approximation technique Slow (Avoid Overshoot) (default) | Fast (Minimize Error)

params.name: Reset if relative extrapolation error exceeds
params.values: Error tolerance for solver reset inf (default) | non-negative real scalar

params.name: Allow continuous input
params.values: Apply hold on continuous signals off (default) | on
